workflow: List and open saved profiles
input: offset/limit; exact profile id
output: Saved summaries/revisions and portable document with machine-local assignments
effect: Read only; no activation
guard: Authenticated read scope; bounded pages
lifecycle: Library observations invalidate summaries; reread current revision
scenario: List profiles, open one and compare saved revision and assignments in UI/MCP.

workflow: Create, rename and duplicate profile
input: name; existing id and expectedRevision for MCP rename/duplicate; operationId
output: Saved profile identity and revision
effect: Persist library change without applying outputs
guard: Configure access; native profile limits, name validation and revision admission
lifecycle: The UI begins New and Copy in an unsaved editor. MCP create and duplicate persist immediately. The editor-session proposals in core-contracts.md cover begin, abandon and save.
scenario: Begin New or Copy, edit a name and discard. The saved library and applied owner must stay unchanged. Separately verify durable create, rename and duplicate acknowledgements.

workflow: Delete saved profile
input: id, expectedRevision, operationId
output: Deleted profile/library receipt or native rejection
effect: Remove saved graph and assignments
guard: Default profile protected; revision and native ownership admission authoritative
lifecycle: Stale revision fails; reconcile actual library after uncertain reply
scenario: Delete disposable profile and test stale revision/default-profile rejection.

workflow: Import and export portable profile
input: Portable document and optional import name; saved id for export
output: Fresh imported identity or portable JSON
effect: Import saves independent graph; export reads saved graph
guard: Strict nested schema/bounds; UI 512 KiB portable limit; no credentials/local assignments exported
lifecycle: Unsaved editor content is distinct from saved export; import never applies
scenario: Export saved profile, import it and verify fresh identity and absent machine assignments.

workflow: Author profile resources, routes, processing and vehicle tabs
input: Full typed ProfileDocument or bounded typed edits; expectedRevision; separate local assignments
output: draftId, deterministic diff, validation, compiler report; saved revision after commit
effect: MCP preparation is ephemeral and prepared save persists only. UI editor Save can replace its own active run after committing. Preserve the separate persistence and application outcomes.
guard: src-tauri/src/mcp_tools/authoring.rs prepare/save_prepared; strict types, native compiler, client-owned draft and optimistic revision
lifecycle: MCP drafts expire after 30 minutes or restart. The visible working copy, undo/redo, discard and save-with-application require the editor-session contract in core-contracts.md.
scenario: Compare prep/save-only with editor Save on its active profile. Verify saved and applied revisions independently, including persistence success followed by failed application.

workflow: Discover profile resource ports and processing operations
input: resourceId, search/category, offset/limit
output: Stable identity, typed port contracts, capability stamps and operation parameter schemas
effect: Metadata only; no ownership or output
guard: Bounded matching pages; native compiler remains compatibility authority
lifecycle: Refresh descriptors when capabilityStamp changes; retained offline resources are not live authority
scenario: Search exact resource ports and processing schema, then compile a matching and mismatching route.

workflow: Select a saved profile without applying it
ui: src/lib/profiles.ts ProfilesClient.select exists; no visible UI invocation found by committed-HEAD search
input: Saved profile id and selectionSource
output: Selected profile/session state
effect: Native/UI changes selection without applying outputs
guard: Native selection and ownership admission
lifecycle: Selection is distinct from saved and applied snapshots
scenario: Native-only selection coverage: verify caller/UI exposure before treating absent MCP selection as manual portal parity gap.

workflow: Activate saved profile and inspect/cancel activation
input: id, expectedRevision, expectedActiveOwner or explicit null; optional gameId; operationId
output: Activation identity, progress, cancellation capability and final native owner/outcome
effect: Acquires runtime resources and applies saved profile through staged native admission
guard: Exact revision/owner, resource capabilities, recovery and platform gates
lifecycle: Poll returned activation identity; cancellation epoch cannot stop newer owner; cleanup is not cancelled
scenario: Apply profile, observe progress, cancel pending attempt and ensure unrelated/newer owner is preserved.

workflow: Stop active profile and retry cleanup
input: operationId; fresh status for reconciliation
output: Stopped/cleanup/recovery state and retained owner diagnostics
effect: Stop neutralizes outputs; recover retries cleanup without replaying graph
guard: Emergency cleanup has separate request capacity; native retained ownership rules
lifecycle: Distinguish stopped, recovery pending and fault; timeout is not rollback
scenario: Stop running profile and inspect cleanup; retry retained cleanup without reactivation.

workflow: Set automatic selection and per-game rule/preference
input: scope, gameId when relevant, exact expectedSettingsRevision and expectedActiveOwner, typed settings
output: Revisioned selection policy/rule/preference
effect: Persists policy; Automatic may activate a matching verified context
guard: Eligible profile and game identity, exact settings revision and owner; strict scope fields
lifecycle: Manual pins selection; explicit Automatic can clear stop pin; rule edits may affect current activation
scenario: Save disabled rule, enable Automatic in verified context, observe native activation and stale settings rejection.

workflow: Pin profile virtual controller to local vJoy slot
input: Canonical profile id, expectedRevision, nodeId, slot 1..16 or null
output: Machine-local slot assignment
effect: Persists pin without acquiring slot or activating
guard: Exact saved profile revision and portable node identifier
lifecycle: Pins separate from portable export; external slot ownership checked at activation
scenario: Pin/unpin virtual node, export profile and verify pin remains machine-local.

workflow: Learn physical controller inputs
input: Exact resourceId, generation, capabilityRevision; returned learnId
output: Passive capture phase and candidate ports
effect: Capture only; no graph edit or output
guard: Current physical resource identity and capability generation; exact capture cancellation
lifecycle: Inspect after observation invalidation; cancel withdraws candidates; reconnect requires fresh evidence
scenario: Start capture, move physical/debug-backed input, read candidates and cancel exact learnId.

workflow: Inspect applied samples and topology
input: Exact applied owner; optional nodeId; nodes/edges section; bounded page
output: Declared-port values and immutable applied graph
effect: Passive inspection
guard: Saved/selected profile cannot impersonate applied owner; owner-derived SHA-256 topic
lifecycle: Subscription ends when owner stops/replaces; refresh owner after replacement
scenario: Inspect running graph then stop/reapply; reject old owner sample reads.

workflow: Preflight saved/draft profile and simulate desktop output
input: Typed draft and assignments; compilationId; bounded frames/advances for desktop preview
output: Readiness, requirements, diagnostics, budgets and pure simulated desktop trace
effect: No save or real desktop injection
guard: Native compiler and bounded preview schema; inspect current compilation
lifecycle: Profile/inventory changes stale UI preflight; expired compilation needs fresh prepare
scenario: Compile graph with desktop route, inspect error and preview trace without acquiring real keyboard/mouse.

workflow: Drive authored debug controller in running profile
input: Exact owner, nodeId, streamId, increasing decimal sequence, bounded changes
output: Volatile debug values and accepted sequence
effect: Feeds authored debug controls into real running profile; values persist until update/Stop
guard: Exact applied owner and declared ports; 16 streams/controller, bounded backpressure; streaming identity replaces operationId
lifecycle: Exact retries harmless; stale/reordered sequence rejected; Stop clears runtime
scenario: Drive button/axis through profile route, replay exact sequence and reject stale owner after Stop.

workflow: Recover or acknowledge retired output/provisioning records
input: Exact inspected reference including recordHash/owner; provisioning jobId for cancel
output: Retained cleanup state, recovery job/outcome
effect: Retry exact cleanup; acknowledgement sends no output
guard: Exact record identity/hash and explicit confirmation before uncertain ownership acknowledgement
lifecycle: Observe profiles.retired-recovery then reread; cancel exact provisioning job
scenario: Inspect retained fixture, recover exact record and reject stale hash/reference.

workflow: List registered games and read details/vehicle catalogue
mcp: games_list; game_vehicles_list; game_read_model_page; game_aircraft_resource; games.state/detail observations
input: gameId/search/page; issued immutable digest+offset; installed DCS vehicleId for registration
output: Game readiness/setup revisions, current context, vehicle catalogue and optional registered aircraft resource
effect: Reads passive; aircraft resource registration changes authoring discovery without provider activation
guard: Digest/byte-count verification; installed DCS catalogue validation; metadata is not live readiness
lifecycle: Expired immutable identity requires new observation baseline
scenario: Inspect game, page vehicles and register installed DCS catalogue without starting provider/profile.

workflow: Discover installed games and review/apply scan
input: Optional existing local root folders; scanId; paged filters; selected actions and optional executable/replacement
output: Immediate scan identity, progress, Add/Update/Remove review, atomic apply receipt
effect: Scan changes no catalogue until Apply
guard: Immediate child folders only; platform tree exclusion; selected installation evidence revalidated; stale scan fails atomically
lifecycle: Subscribe jobs before start; ready then applied are distinct states
scenario: Scan fixture folder, review selected Add/unselected Remove, apply exact scan and verify catalogue.

workflow: Add, rename, remove, rescan and choose game installation/executable
input: Root-contained executable/name; gameId; exact installationId; optional metadata
output: Registered catalogue/settings receipt and subsequent game state
effect: Persists local library; rescan refreshes only target game; no launch/provider start
guard: Executable must lie inside selected root for direct add; native installation validation
lifecycle: Removal leaves profiles with unavailable context; rescan preserves tags/user artwork
scenario: Add disposable local game, edit name/executable, choose installation, rescan and remove; inspect profile context fallout.

workflow: Read game metadata and edit tags/taxonomy
input: gameId; tagIds with exact expectedTagIds; complete taxonomy with expectedTags
output: Cached Wikidata provenance/metadata or normal unmatched state; saved taxonomy/tags
effect: Metadata read performs no network; tag operations persist lists
guard: Optimistic equality; 32 unique tags/game; 128 taxonomy entries; bounded validated ids/names
lifecycle: Rescan populates cached metadata; concurrent edits rejected
scenario: Read unmatched/cached metadata, save tags, then reject stale expectedTagIds/taxonomy.

workflow: Choose/crop/reset game artwork
input: gameId and issued artworkId; bounded imageData/normalized crop or reset path:null
output: Cached thumbnail/full preview and saved background receipt
effect: Preview is read only; explicit save persists image/crop
guard: Exact game artwork identity; bounded image and normalized 16:9 crop
lifecycle: Full preview precedes alignment/save; cancellation leaves saved image
scenario: Preview artwork, crop/save and reset; verify UI persisted background matches MCP receipt.

workflow: Launch game with matching profile and remembered choice
mcp: No game launch/candidates tool; explicit exclusion in catalogue workflow/security text
input: gameId, expectedActiveOwner, optional profileId/rememberChoice
output: Started launch acknowledgement and matching running/degraded applied owner
effect: Activates chosen profile before launching executable
guard: Native executable/platform readiness, candidate context, owner/switch confirmation
lifecycle: UI validates exact launch acknowledgement then reads applied owner; errors require status/cleanup reconciliation
scenario: Launch fixture game from UI with two matching profiles; demonstrate MCP cannot perform equivalent launch.

workflow: Check/setup/repair/cancel/remove/recover game integration
input: Registered gameId; optional DCS userFolder/provider connection; exact jobId for cancel
output: Bounded acknowledgement; games.jobs/detail carries setup phase/result/recovery
effect: Native integration workflow can modify managed setup files or start bounded verification
guard: Selected installation/provider validation; DCS closed for retained recovery; native managed-file cleanup checks
lifecycle: Subscribe jobs/detail before action; acknowledgement may precede completion; resolve immutable detail pages
scenario: Set up disposable integration fixture, observe progress, cancel exact job, check/remove and recover interrupted DCS fixture.

workflow: Save machine-local provider connection/catalogue settings
input: gameId, exact settings revision/active owner, strict connection and optional DCS userFolder/aircraftModule
output: Revisioned provider preferences/setup state
effect: Persist preferences without launch or direct profile apply
guard: Strict per-provider fields; native addresses/ports/freshness/path/catalogue validation
lifecycle: Concurrent UI/MCP or external edit rejected; reread before retry
scenario: Change supported provider freshness/settings, verify native UI agreement and unknown-field/stale revision rejection.

workflow: Enable/cancel game process monitoring
input: Observed registered X-Plane/Assetto gameId
output: Permission/helper progress and game state
effect: Requests Windows permission for temporary notifications helper; cancel withdraws telemetry authority
guard: Native platform/consent/current-session gates; no installed service or simulator command
lifecycle: May await Windows consent; cancel closes helper and removes session authority
scenario: Enable fixture monitoring, inspect UI/MCP progress and cancel; ensure telemetry authority withdrawn.

workflow: Inspect incoming game telemetry
input: Optional gameId, search/group and bounded page
output: Canonical channels and bounded fresh values
effect: Inspection; X-Plane requests selected datarefs from existing source
guard: Existing native source/session/freshness qualification; no arbitrary simulator command
lifecycle: Capture/expiry invalidations trigger reread; high-frequency general telemetry streaming excluded
scenario: Feed native telemetry fixture, inspect grouped values and verify stale/expired samples withdraw.

workflow: Inspect system devices, USB details and host controller inputs
native: system_inventory; controller_list/inspect and exact observation topics
mcp: system_inventory; resources_list/resource_inspect; system.inventory and controllers.inventory plus exact controller/USB observation topics
input: First page refresh:true; offset/limit and captured observedAt; observed exact detail topic
output: Committed inventory, identity/online evidence and passive input/details frames
effect: Explicit native inspection or cached passive reads; no output acquisition
guard: Stable captured inventory paging; passive observations have no ownership authority
lifecycle: Visibility-scoped UI readers release on hide; new inventory timestamp required after refresh
scenario: Refresh system inventory, page with observedAt, compare host controller/USB detail and verify observer release on navigation.

workflow: Rename/reclassify host controller
input: sourceId, name, role controller/joystick/wheelbase/pedals/throttle/panel
output: Saved source id/name/role
effect: Persist local metadata
guard: Fresh inventory/source identity; strict role/name validation
lifecycle: Inventory observation updates saved details
scenario: Rename fixture controller and role through MCP; compare HostControllers fields after observation.

workflow: Reassign moved host controller to remembered offline identity
input: Remembered offline sourceId and current observedId
output: Updated stable controller association
effect: Persist physical connection reassignment
guard: Native controller identity/eligibility checks; UI requires fresh inventory
lifecycle: Reconcile current and offline identities after movement; stale inventory must not overwrite
scenario: Create moved/offline fixture identities, reassign in UI and demonstrate missing MCP equivalent.

workflow: Forget offline controllers/modules and cleanup device inventory
ui: src/lib/SystemDevices.svelte forget; HostControllers.svelte Forget offline controller; system-inventory-providers.ts forget
native: controller_forget; gateway forget; frontend remembered metadata removal; companion_revoke for companions
mcp: No controller_forget/gateway forget tools; ui_preferences_save remembered is metadata only; companion_revoke covers its own trust domain
input: Reviewed offline device identities and stored references
output: Per-device cleanup/revocation result and remaining inventory
effect: Remove eligible remembered identities; companion revoke also changes trust
guard: Offline, unowned, visible/eligible; profile reference checks; fresh cleanup review
lifecycle: Native identity forget differs from editing remembered cache; cancel stops remaining batch, not committed deletions
scenario: Cleanup mixed offline inventory; prove MCP companion revoke works while controller/module forget remains unavailable.

workflow: Inspect/save/restore physical controller visibility
input: sourceId; typed visibility intent; observed jobId/sessionId and exact expectedActiveOwner for restore
output: Saved intent, inspected platform/HidHide rules and recovery/job state
effect: Save only persists local intent; restore may stop exact profile/output and restore recorded rules
guard: Physical source qualification, platform support and exact owner/session admission
lifecycle: Inspect fresh evidence; restore exact observed recovery/job; intent is not already applied hiding
scenario: Save visibility preference without hiding, inspect native evidence, restore exact fixture session and reject stale owner.

workflow: Discover/connect/disconnect gateway
input: Exact discovered gatewayId; action connect/disconnect; expectedActiveOwner
output: Gateway identity/session/state and typed module capabilities
effect: Open/close exact native gateway endpoint
guard: Shared profile admission prevents independent setup takeover of applied owner
lifecycle: Discovery does not open endpoint; reconnect/boot changes require fresh module baseline
scenario: Discover and connect debug gateway, inspect modules, disconnect and reject operation conflicting with active profile.

workflow: Read, prepare, claim and configure CAN/gateway module
mcp: gateway_config_read; device_config_prepare transport gateway; gateway_config_change; workspace_client_renew
input: gatewayId/moduleId; complete RuntimeConfig for Apply; action and exact expectedActiveOwner
output: Baseline boot/route/generation, deterministic diff, claim/config/readback and persistence result
effect: Prepare validates only; explicit claim/action applies RAM state or separately persists
guard: Native boot/route/writer/lease, firmware semantics, USB preference and cross-transport exclusion
lifecycle: Renew only owned unexpired config leases while editing; reconnect invalidates baseline; no ambiguous write replay
scenario: Read/prepare config, claim, apply RAM-only, save, discard/reset and release; compare dirty/savedGeneration and stale-route rejection.

workflow: Discover/connect/read/configure direct USB module
mcp: usb_modules_list; usb_module_inspect; usb_module_session; usb_module_config_read; device_config_prepare transport usb; usb_module_config_change
input: Observed key/port; exact current route; complete RuntimeConfig; action/expectedActiveOwner
output: USB identity/admissibility, route, configuration baseline/diff and explicit action readback
effect: Explicit connect/config ownership; RAM Apply and durable save remain separate
guard: Verified endpoint identity, current boot/route/config generation, client claim and profile ownership
lifecycle: Reconnect/reboot needs fresh route; release claim when editing ends
scenario: Inspect exact USB fixture, connect, read/prepare, claim/apply_save/release; reject stale route and competing owner.

workflow: Calibrate axes and map module physical input layout
native: RuntimeConfig validation/encoder via config_apply or module_usb_config_apply
input: Complete RuntimeConfig with axes raw min/max, normalized neutral/deadzone and mappings
output: Validation/diff and firmware accepted/rejected configuration readback
effect: Explicit Apply updates calibration/layout; Save persists
guard: 12-bit ADC raw 0..4095; typed array/range/capability validation; firmware contact/layout checks
lifecycle: Changed controller counts/usages/neutrals can require separate USB layout publication, currently absent MCP controls
scenario: Prepare valid calibration and invalid range, apply valid fixture configuration and compare live calibrated input.

workflow: Enable/disable/update/register gateway USB controller and apply layout
native: enable; disable; update-profile; forget; register/unregister; reconnect/apply/save on gateway
mcp: No corresponding gateway lifecycle/layout tool in catalogue.rs
input: Exact gateway/module and reviewed controller/layout action
output: Saved controller roster/layout pending/error and reconnect outcome
effect: Changes gateway USB controller order/publication; may reconnect USB
guard: Module/controller capability, claims/layoutPending, native profile mutation admission; UI confirmation for disruptive actions
lifecycle: Enabled changed controls remain neutral until explicit profile/layout update; auto lifecycle saves/reconnects; older gateway requires Apply layout
scenario: Change fixture module control counts, perform UI Update controller profile/Disable/Enable and verify layout/reconnect; demonstrate missing MCP action.

workflow: Inspect passive CAN/module inputs
ui: src/App.svelte Live inputs; src/lib/DebugControls.svelte calibrated preview
native: can_input_inspect; exact can.inputs.<gateway serial>.<module identity> topic
input: Observed exact CAN topic
output: Fresh passive calibrated input preview
effect: Read only; sends no device command
guard: Observed current gateway/module identity and freshness
lifecycle: Input preview withdraws on disconnect/route changes; no read means no output authority
scenario: Drive software CAN fixture and compare live UI calibrated values with inspected topic; disconnect withdraws preview.

workflow: Discover and invoke standalone module actions
native: action_describe; action_state; action_invoke; USB module actions commands
mcp: No standalone action discovery/invocation tool; catalogue explicitly excludes standalone device action invocation
input: moduleId, boot, catalogueRevision, actionId, typed values
output: Advertised action/state or uncertain/error/unsupported result
effect: Manual native action can operate physical outputs independently of profile routes
guard: Advertised firmware contracts, exact boot/catalogue, action readiness, profile blocking and ownership admission
lifecycle: Uncertain command requires state refresh; physical output verification remains separate from readback
scenario: Discover fixture output action, invoke from UI, inspect readback; demonstrate MCP only supports authored profile route alternative, not equivalent manual invocation.

workflow: Create/manage simulated devices and drive raw simulated inputs
native: debug_describe; debug_invoke add/online/reboot/direct/neutral and raw input operations
mcp: No debug_describe/debug_invoke tools; profile_debug_controller_input addresses different authored runtime nodes
input: Preset; exact moduleId/boot; debugOperation and bounded raw args
output: Simulator device roster/boot/online/raw and calibrated state
effect: Creates/reboots software modules, toggles routes and feeds normal calibration/event pipeline
guard: Connected debug gateway, advertised presets, boot and layout readiness; input queue ordering
lifecycle: DebugControls resets inputs on exit; reboot changes boot; failed reset requires reconnect/reset before continuing
scenario: Add preset, drive 12-bit raw axis/button, toggle offline/direct route, reboot and reset; contrast with MCP authored debug controller API.

workflow: Reset entire profile library to defaults
ui: src/lib/profiles.ts ProfilesClient.reset exists; no visible reset control confirmed in inspected ProfilesPanel/ProfileLibraryTools
input: Explicit confirm:true
output: Native reset profile/library state
effect: Destructive profile reset through native command
guard: Native profile ownership/mutation authorization; explicit confirmation field
lifecycle: Caller must reconcile active state; UI exposure not confirmed and should not be claimed as manual portal feature
scenario: Native-only reset coverage: inspect admission/tests before deciding whether parity obligation applies; do not assert visible UI action.

workflow: Inspect and install optional drivers or open their configuration utility
native: src-tauri/src/lib.rs optional_dependencies, optional_dependency_install, open_vjoy and open_hidhide. src-tauri/src/optional_dependencies.rs owns allowlisted installation and launch.
mcp: system_inventory and system.inventory.drivers expose installed state. Installer submission, job reconciliation and fixed configuration utility launch are proposed in core-contracts.md.
input: Pinned dependency ID vjoy or hidhide, observed manifest and system revision, expected owner, operation UUID.
output: Bundled package identity, platform availability, job phase, native outcome and subsequent installed-state readback.
effect: Reads inspect local state. Installation writes system files and can require elevation or restart. Opening the utility starts an external application.
guard: Native Windows x64 eligibility, fixed manifest, package size/hash, installation and ownership preflight. OS elevation stays with the operator.
lifecycle: Serialize installs. Reconcile an interrupted reply against job and installed state. A cancelled elevation produces no successful install receipt.
scenario: Reject a mismatched manifest and concurrent install. Compare denial, restart-required and fresh installed version through both entry points.

workflow: Route advertised input events and feedback through an applied profile
ui: src/lib/ProfileRoutingEditor.svelte and src/lib/ProfileCanvas.svelte author resource ports and explicit connections.
native: src/lib/profile-compilation.ts describes compiled physical-action, physical-state and companion-feedback sinks. The profile compiler and native session admit and own the routes.
mcp: resource_search_ports, profile_prepare_changes, compilation_inspect, profile_save_prepared, profile_apply and profile_status
input: Exact resource and port identities, typed graph and local assignments, saved revision and observed active owner.
output: Compiler diagnostics, saved document revision and applied session owner. Feedback state and delivery depend on the connected endpoint.
effect: Discovery and preparation inspect. Applying acquires eligible routes and can deliver actual output.
guard: Existing provider availability, advertised capability, revision, route and active owner checks apply to both surfaces.
lifecycle: Stop releases the profile-owned routes. Reconnect requires current capability and route evidence.
scenario: Prepare an advertised event-to-feedback binding. Verify compiler admission, exact applied owner and feedback withdrawal on Stop. Physical receipt requires independent device evidence.
